description: This file defines the IRemoteConnection interface and related types within the WPEFramework RPC namespace. It includes virtual methods for managing remote connections, notifications, and interface acquisition, serving as a contract for implementing remote connection handling in the system.

classes.name: IRemoteConnection
classes.description: Interface for managing remote connections, including identification, termination, and interface acquisition.

classes.name: IRemoteConnection::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for remote connection events such as activation, deactivation, and termination.

methods.name: IRemoteConnection::Id
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the remote connection.

methods.name: IRemoteConnection::RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier associated with the connection.

methods.name: IRemoteConnection::Acquire
methods.description: Acquires an interface pointer based on class name, interface ID, and version, with a wait time.

methods.name: IRemoteConnection::Launch
methods.description: Launches the remote connection or associated process.

methods.name: IRemoteConnection::INotification::Activated
methods.description: Called when the remote connection is activated.

methods.name: IRemoteConnection::INotification::Deactivated
methods.description: Called when the remote connection is deactivated.

methods.name: IRemoteConnection::INotification::Terminated
methods.description: Called when the remote connection is terminated.
